minutes.headline: Finance Committee reviewed draft town financial policies and readied questions for town-school department merger talks.
minutes.summary: The Finance Committee discussed a draft town financial policies document, planning to ask the finance director and town manager about how it differs from current practice. Much of the meeting previewed the upcoming tri-board meeting on combining town and school functions (HR, IT, facilities) and health insurance, and committee reports covered the Municipal Building Design Committee's plans for Town Hall/Ritter and the Brooks House, plus interest in Marshall Park's revenue potential.

what_happened.line: The committee prepared questions for an August 26 tri-board meeting on merging town and school functions, including HR, IT, facilities and health insurance.
Members decided to invite the finance director and town manager to a future meeting to explain how a new draft financial policy document differs from current practice.
The committee agreed to stretch out the departmental budget submission schedule, with a written timeline to come, so meetings are not compressed as they were the prior year.
Members agreed to raise questions at their own Finance Committee meetings first so they can bring a unified position into the tri-board talks.

why_it_matters: Combining town and school HR, IT, facilities and health insurance would change how those services are staffed and paid for, a shift residents would see reflected in future budgets.
A revised budget submission calendar changes when each department's figures reach the committee, which affects how much review happens before town meeting.
watch_next: The August 26 tri-board meeting on town-school function consolidation
A future Finance Committee meeting with the finance director and/or town manager on the draft financial policy document
